treatmentJourney.title: Consultation & 3D iTero Scan
treatmentJourney.description: Your journey begins with a complimentary consultation, including a 3D iTero scan to precisely map your teeth and preview your future smile with Invisalign.

treatmentJourney.title: Custom Treatment Plan
treatmentJourney.description: Based on your scan, a personalized treatment plan is created, detailing every tooth movement. Your custom Invisalign aligners are then manufactured.

treatmentJourney.title: First Aligners Delivered
treatmentJourney.description: Receive your first sets of aligners along with detailed instructions and coaching on how to wear and care for them effectively.

treatmentJourney.title: Progress Check-Ins
treatmentJourney.description: Regular check-ups every 6-10 weeks allow Dr. Mawaldi to monitor your progress and ensure your teeth are moving as planned.

treatmentJourney.title: Refinement Aligners
treatmentJourney.description: If needed, refinement aligners are provided to make any final fine-tuning adjustments, ensuring the perfect alignment of your smile.

treatmentJourney.title: Retention & Maintenance
treatmentJourney.description: Upon completion, you'll receive custom retainers to preserve your beautiful new smile long-term, supported by our Peace of Mind Retainer Program.

faqItems.question: How long does Invisalign treatment typically take?
faqItems.answer: The duration of Invisalign treatment varies depending on the complexity of your case, but many patients complete their treatment in 12-18 months. Shorter treatments like Invisalign Express are available for minor adjustments.

faqItems.question: How much does Invisalign cost, and is it covered by insurance?
faqItems.answer: Invisalign costs are comparable to traditional braces. LifeSmile Orthodontics offers flexible interest-free payment plans and accepts all PPO insurances to help make treatment affordable and maximize your benefits.

faqItems.question: How many hours a day do I need to wear my Invisalign aligners?
faqItems.answer: For optimal results, it is recommended to wear your Invisalign aligners for 20-22 hours per day, removing them only to eat, drink, brush, and floss.

faqItems.question: Can Invisalign fix my specific bite issue?
faqItems.answer: Invisalign can effectively correct a wide range of orthodontic issues, including overbites, underbites, crossbites, and open bites. A complimentary consultation can determine if it's right for you.

faqItems.question: Will Invisalign hurt or affect my speech?
faqItems.answer: You may experience some pressure or mild discomfort when first wearing new aligners, which typically subsides quickly. While a slight lisp might occur initially, most patients adapt quickly.

faqItems.question: What happens after Invisalign treatment, do I need a retainer forever?
faqItems.answer: After your Invisalign treatment, wearing a retainer is crucial to maintain your new smile and prevent teeth from shifting back. LifeSmile Orthodontics offers a Peace of Mind Retainer Program to help protect your investment.
